answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The beacon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The hollow holds work receipts rather than names, so the delta of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
